toy_disease_zero_shot.description: Scaled EchoGround-style zero-shot disease classification. Paper reference values are from the EchoVLM full objective and CLIP-only objective rows in Table 6.

auc.description: Area under the disease probe ROC curve on the embedding similarity margin.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean of positive-class recall and negative-class specificity, included to catch threshold shortcuts on the imbalanced disease slice.

precision.description: Positive predictive value at the fixed zero similarity-margin threshold.

recall.description: Positive-class sensitivity at the fixed zero similarity-margin threshold. Reported as a diagnostic because the toy artifact has too few positive threshold errors to make recall a reliable split score.

caption_retrieval_mrr.description: Mean reciprocal rank of each image's paired affirmative caption within the slice, probing image-text alignment beyond the disease threshold.

hard_negative_accuracy.description: Percentage of examples where the image is closer to its affirmative caption than to its paired negated caption.

negation_cosine.description: Average cosine similarity between affirmative and negated caption embeddings; lower values reward separation of negated clinical statements.

positive_vs_negated_margin.description: Average image-to-positive-caption similarity minus image-to-negated-caption similarity, measuring whether the representation separates affirmative findings from negations.
